ja266:1.1: That by which you grew thin, yellow, and did not take delight in food,
ja266:1.4: why at this time do you run away?
ja266:2.1: If at the beginning itself what’s called intimacy arises,
ja266:2.3: For women their fame is lost,
ja266:2.4: therefore, my dear, I do run away.
ja266:3.1: Not desiring to come to one born in a renowned family,
ja266:3.3: She will grieve for a long time,
